Hi all — quick technical gating questions from the PDM side so we can scope the handshake: 

1) Listing type: you mentioned SaaS subscription. Will you be using AWS Marketplace SaaS Contracts (metered entitlements) or self-fulfillment via AMI/CloudFormation?
2) Fulfillment: how will entitlements be validated (JWT, webhook, token exchange, or API key)? We need a short flow diagram for the Solutions Engineering review.
3) Multi-tenant model: you noted single-tenant per customer — are you planning a per-customer AWS account with an onboarding job, or a hosted single-tenant instance per customer in our customer's VPC? This affects entitlement and billing.
4) Compliance: please provide latest SOC2 report or the auditor name and date; if pending, list compensating controls.
5) Support & escalation: proposed SEA/EU support hours and target SLA for incidents.

If you can provide short answers in this thread and upload the completed intake + network diagram to the Drive link I shared (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aegis-ACE-Intake), we can confirm the ACE path.

Suggested tech handshake attendees: Kimberly (PDM), Karthik (PSM/SE), Brian (AegisMed eng lead), Tanya Singh (AegisMed product). Suggest a 30-min slot Oct 15 at 09:30 PST.

Thanks — I can take the lead on the marketplace intake once we have the items above.

Kimberly Park
Partner Development Manager | Redwood Inference
